name: Holland Village
summary: Walkable café strip, expat-familiar conveniences, and a soft landing for first housing searches.
body: Holland Village sits between Dempsey and Bukit Timah — close enough to international schools and clubs that many arriving families treat it as a default shortlist. Lorong Mambong and Holland Avenue deliver groceries, takeaway, and evening tables without a car; the MRT station makes CBD days workable. Expect a mix of walk-up apartments, older condos, and a few newer towers. Weekends feel social; weekdays feel practical. It is not quiet, and it is not cheap — but it is legible if you are new to Singapore.
watchOuts: Limited large family floorplans in the core
housingMix: Condos and older walk-ups; limited landed nearby.
commuteNotes: Circle Line at Holland Village; bus spines to Orchard and Buona Vista.
